reference: Own DSTS chr042 FunBeemon model and clips. PMDO engine registry supplies action names, timing and events.
flight_policy: Fixed row-82 shadow on padded action canvas; native wingbeats and vertical bob are retained.
eye_policy: Retain source pale eyes, green iris and native dark detail; no speculative pupil or eyelid.

actions.name: Walk
actions.pose_evidence: Native forward flight and alternating wingbeat; loop endpoint excluded.

actions.name: Attack
actions.pose_evidence: Native head and forelimb lunge while flying.

actions.name: Shoot
actions.pose_evidence: Native upright release gesture; no projectile asset.

actions.name: Sleep
actions.pose_evidence: Native resting flight and lowered forelimbs; source eye closure uncertain at native scale.

actions.name: Hurt
actions.pose_evidence: Native recoil and disrupted wing motion.

actions.name: Swing
actions.pose_evidence: First 0.96s of native sweep, then recovery; later native clip dives entirely out of sprite view.

actions.name: Double
actions.pose_evidence: Two native strike cycles; PMDO XML has one HitFrame.

actions.name: Hop
actions.pose_evidence: Native high flight arc on a padded action canvas; no forced landing.

actions.name: Charge
actions.pose_evidence: Native forelimb strain and reverse-sampled recovery. Horizontal root travel is anchored; vertical/rotational motion remains.

actions.name: Rotate
actions.pose_evidence: Native flight Idle wingbeat with explicit whole-view yaw; fq01 travels beyond fixed sprite framing.
